# LangChain — LangSmith for Startups

Two tiers: Build gives discounted seat pricing to first-time customers with under $10M raised; Scale gives $10K in LangSmith credits valid for 1 year to Series A or earlier startups backed by a LangChain premier VC partner.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $10,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | If you are eligible, your credits will be available to you within a few days of applying and are available for 1 year. Those in Y Combinator will have 2 years to use their credits. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build | — | If you are a first-time customer with less than $10M in funding, and have raised at least $25K in seed funding, | No partner needed |
| Scale | $10,000 | If you are a first-time customer backed by a LangChain premier VC partner, and are Series A (up to $50M in funding) or earlier stage, | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Existing LangSmith customers (both tiers require a first-time customer)

### Notes

Top-level funding bounds reflect the Build tier (at least $25K raised, under $10M). The Scale tier instead requires Series A or earlier with up to $50M raised AND backing by a LangChain premier VC partner; both tiers are captured separately in tiers[]. The Build tier card is headed 'For early-stage, VC-backed startups and founders.' but the FAQ says a non-partner VC or accelerator does not block Build eligibility, so requires_vc_backing is left unknown. 'Additional eligibility criteria may apply' is stated but not enumerated. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
